metadata.source: Engine simulation; not real-world outcome frequencies
metadata.note: Deterministic seed 1; no host bots, external events, weather shocks, prize money or human officials. Built-in law runs. Fixed legal orders; exceptions explicitly described per probe. Monetary outputs are model calculations, not researched prices.
metadata.selectionSource: data/places.json; anchor distances and modelled footfall; classification is an audit estimate
metadata.ranking: Surviving profiles first, then cumulative reported profit over the year; ties within one cent count as shared winners.

profiles.note: Provisional audit policy, not observed NYC financial data. Seats come from kit sizes; staffing is a chosen decision. Specialty price is refPrice + $1, an explicit grid point from the prior audit. No coefficients are added to the engine.
